SELECT r.id, r.main_id, r.detail_id, r.detail_sub_id, r.logistics_bill_id, lb.code AS logistics_bill_code, r.logistics_bill_detail_id, r.logistics_bill_cost_id, lbc.code AS logistics_bill_cost_code, r.tms_cost_detail_id, r.match_type, r.match_user_id, r.match_user_name, r.match_time, r.import_type, r.reconciliation_status FROM logistics_recon_ref_logistics_bill r LEFT JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lb.id = r.logistics_bill_id AND lb.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN logistics_bill_cost lbc ON lbc.id = r.logistics_bill_cost_id AND lbc.is_deleted = false WHERE r.is_deleted = false AND r.detail_id IN
#{detailId}

SELECT r.id, r.main_id, r.detail_id, r.detail_sub_id, r.logistics_bill_id, lb.code AS logistics_bill_code, r.logistics_bill_detail_id, r.logistics_bill_cost_id, lbc.code AS logistics_bill_cost_code, r.tms_cost_detail_id, r.match_type, r.match_user_id, r.match_user_name, r.match_time, r.import_type, r.reconciliation_status FROM logistics_recon_ref_logistics_bill r LEFT JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lb.id = r.logistics_bill_id AND lb.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN logistics_bill_cost lbc ON lbc.id = r.logistics_bill_cost_id AND lbc.is_deleted = false WHERE r.is_deleted = false AND r.main_id = #{mainId}
